prompt:
Portrait comic page, 2:3 ratio, narrow white margins, three equal horizontal panels read from top to bottom. Read text within each panel from left to right. Clean two-dimensional comic outlines, soft flat colors, and natural morning light.
Reference image 1 guides style only. Reference image 2 is a character sheet and guides identity only: do not copy its panels or background. Reference image 3 guides the entrance hall's decor, furniture, and spatial layout. Only the mother and child appear; do not import unrelated reference characters.
Characters: mother, about 40, short black hair and a beige coat; child, about 10, chin-length black hair, blue hoodie, and red backpack. The home entrance has pale walls, a wooden front door, and a low shoe cabinet beside it. Keep the same layout, camera direction, and morning light across all panels. The dark suitcase belongs to the mother; the child keeps wearing the red backpack.
Panel 1, establishing view: the door is open. The mother stands at it holding the suitcase handle; the child watches from inside. First read a rectangular upper-left narration box with the exact text: "Early morning. Mum was heading out." Then read the mother's upper-right speech balloon, its tail clearly pointing to her, with the exact text: "See you after school." Neither text box hides faces or the suitcase handle.
Panel 2, medium view: in the same entrance, the mother steps outside with her suitcase. The child waves from the original position, still wearing the red backpack; the door remains open. One upper-left speech balloon points to the child and contains exactly: "Okay. Take care." This is the child's speech, not narration.
Panel 3, medium view: the same door is now closed. The mother and suitcase have left the image. The child remains in the original position, hand lowered, backpack still on, with a calm expression. The cabinet, walls, and morning light remain continuous. A rectangular upper-left narration box has no speech tail and contains exactly: "The door closed. The house grew quiet."
Include only these four exact text items, each once, with complete and legible letters. Narration uses rectangular boxes; dialogue uses balloons pointing to speakers. Add no incidental text, labels, or watermarks on the door, clothing, backpack, or suitcase. Keep recognizable characters and spatial continuity without adding events or people.
